taxonomic_note: Accepted Tragia brevispica Engelm. & A.Gray under the current project treatment.
look_here_first: Look first at the short reproductive spike and then the leaves. Photograph or inspect the whole raceme with scale because this species can disappear among other stinging Tragia when only vegetative characters are used.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is locked by University of Michigan specimen 1645723; Bexar by New York herbarium specimen evidence; Comal by 1846–47 Lindheimer material from New Braunfels after reconciling the historical locality to Comal County.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: The Comal assignment is tied to the dated New Braunfels locality after county-history reconciliation; do not generalize other undated historical localities.

best_field_traits: reproductive measurements and raceme architecture are more reliable than general habit
mature fruit is a small 3-lobed capsule typical of the genus
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Use the short raceme together with bract, pedicel, leaf-proportion, and fruit characters; vegetative habit alone is not secure.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Use the short raceme together with bract, pedicel, leaf-proportion, and fruit characters; vegetative habit alone is not secure.

photo_note: Diagnostic image structures are defined in the research draft; exact rights-cleared learner photos remain a later photo-backfill task.
